stem: Which action best explains the differences shown in these photographs?

options.label: A
options.text: The United States gave economic assistance through the Marshall Plan.

options.label: B
options.text: The United States and the Soviet Union created an alliance after World War II.

options.label: C
options.text: U.S. leaders created the United Nations.

options.label: D
options.text: The Soviet Union established the “Iron Curtain” after World War II.

visual_elements: Two black and white photographs showed. The first labeled 'French Steel Plant, 1945' shows a building with damaged roof and debris inside. The second labeled 'The Same French Steel Plant, 1948' shows the building repaired and clear of debris.
